verdict.rationale: A hands-on user reports using Solid for data viz because it is "small and easy to inject into other pages" (solid-comm-8). Solid can also author custom elements (solid-gh-7), which is a natural way to embed interactive widgets in existing markup, and its direct DOM access eases coexistence with existing pages (solid-gh-8). However, no first-party docs describe mounting components into an existing server-rendered page, and setup assumes a JSX build step via Babel or Vite (solid-gh-23, solid-gh-21). Missing for 10: official documentation of mounting into existing server-rendered HTML, a no-build or script-tag drop-in path, and examples of partial or islands-style embedding.
